summary: Great world builder! Launch eco-projects, save animals, protect Earth planet!
description:
🌍 Eco Inc. Save the Earth — a new strategy simulator sandbox in the “Incs” genre from the creators of Religion Inc.

This game was created in consultation with environmental experts and is based on real ecological challenges, climate issues, global environmental risks, and the future of our planet.

Play a variety of environmental scenarios — from easy to nearly impossible — and build your own strategy to protect Earth, restore nature, save wildlife, and guide humanity toward a greener future.

Your mission is to stabilize Earth’s ecosystems, improve the environmental situation on the planet, and prevent a global ecological crisis.
Every action matters — your decisions shape the planet’s future. Your care leads Earth toward harmony, sustainability, green development, and a better terra for future generations.

Game Features:
• Develop environmental initiatives and eco-projects
• Restore ecosystems, forests, oceans, rivers, and natural habitats
• Discover animals from the IUCN Red List and protect endangered species
• Manage climate, pollution, resources, economy, science, and diplomacy
• Diverse gameplay mechanics: from resource management to international cooperation
• Challenging tasks and unexpected events that will test your strategic skills
• Make a real contribution to saving the planet by raising eco-awareness
• Don’t let an ecological disaster spread across the world like a plague
• Strategic planning: create long-term plans for the planet’s survival
• Volunteering: send your heroes to help and participate in global eco-projects
• Economic development: manage resources, invest in clean technologies, and build a green future
• Terra strategy: balance humanity, nature, industry, and global ecosystems

Game information is based on open data, the IUCN Red List, real ecological challenges, and global eco-communities.

We have great plans for future updates!
Share your ideas and feedback in the comments — together with GameFirst, we’ll make the game even better!

by GAMEFIRST.PRO
Creators of Religion Inc. and ECO Inc. STE
Strategy games about big ideas.
